name: zt-digest-base
description: The shared base of the ZT digest workflows: Prepare, the ledger-driven group cycle, the per-group Card checks, Link, Organize, Figures and Hubs joined by the final audit, with slots where a book type installs its own layers (models, explanations, events, findings, math stages), and report-first cross-book Bridges after Figures
whenToUse: Not run by itself: a variant (zt-econ-digest, zt-math-digest) names it in "base", sets consts.profile, and fills its slots

preflight.P1: Goal and result: the base is every stage that all ZT digests share (zt-digest-protocol sections 2-4), first ported from the hand-written zt-book-digest.js (removed 2026-10-16). The result is the report stage's object, in the shape that script returned for each mode, plus a variant's extra reports.
preflight.P2: Inputs: the args of the removed zt-book-digest.js, one declaration each (out required; citationKey, source, bibtex, bookTitle checked per mode by the args stage, as before). 2.4.0 adds book: a Scholar Archive Work id or exact title that resolves source, bibtex, bookTitle and the file through the read-only bridge, so mode full takes book or the three explicit arguments, never a silent mix. They carry data: paths, keys, pilot filters, batch sizes (capped at the DSMP limits in code), DeepSeek efforts (raised to high), and switches that pick among declared conditional stages. architectEffort is gone: the architect role's effort is frozen. Bridge arguments select limits (60/120 sources, 5/8 candidates), target books, report id and separate new/earlier acceptance; work is out/bridge. 3.0.0 adds maxAttempts (1-10, default 3) and dshRunCap (60-3600 s, default 1200): the only new run settings, persisted in the preparation contract by zt-digest prepare, so a resume reuses them. Leases, batch sizes and heartbeat intervals stay versioned tool defaults. 3.0.0 adds maxAttempts (1-10, default 3) and dshRunCap (60-3600 s, default 1200): the only new run settings, persisted in the preparation contract by zt-digest prepare, so a resume reuses them. Leases, batch sizes and heartbeat intervals stay versioned tool defaults.
preflight.P3: Units of work: the run ledger owns readiness. Digest groups are digest/gNNN@1 units claimed one block at a time; each group chain starts its own snapshot and job (R262) and records a checked completion. The Cards layer (cards/gNNN@1), the Model units (models/gNNN-mIIII@1), the explanations (explain/<key>@1), the Events and Findings units, the Terms unit (terms/book@1) and the whole-book card cycle (cards-book/book@N) are worked by a layer driver in bounded blocks. Compiler jobs stay one Haiku manager per 8 jobs, at most 8 managers in the run (the global pool).
preflight.P4: Roles: manager = Haiku, effort low (relays commands, runs DeepSeek managers, clean-ups; reads no book, writes no Card). architect = Sonnet (writes plan.json only). organizer = Opus (writes decisions.json only). Scripts do every structural step; DeepSeek does the labour (DeepSeek Subagent Managed Protocol).
preflight.P5: Stage graph (readiness, R244): args → source → prepare → [after-prepare] → terms → digest (one ready group per manager chain) → cards (the per-group offline checks) → [after-digest: the model layer] → [after-models: explanations] → cards-book → link-prepare → link → link-check → [after-link] → organize → figures ∥ hubs → bridge → audit (joins hubs and bridge) → [after-audit] → cleanup → report. The Event and Finding layers fill [after-terms] and are worked from ledger readiness while the remaining digest groups run; the model layer is released when the digest managers settle, and the whole-book card cycle waits for the Model reviews while model compilation never waits for it.
preflight.P6: Modules: gate (args), zt-dsh-source, zt-digest-prepare, zt-book-terms, zt-group-cycle, zt-cards-layer, zt-cards-book, zt-hubs (hubs-first and hubs), zt-link-prepare, zt-link-pass, zt-link-check, zt-organize, zt-figures, zt-dsh-cleanup, zt-audit, zt-digest-report; all share zt-digest-lib v8 (the ready-work driver). The book type installs its own prompt files and its layers in the slots.
preflight.P7: Checks: every DeepSeek job runs its SELF-CHECK (in the job files the scripts write); zt-check is the only checker; the args stage checks the required args per mode and the kernel validates the finite bounds of maxAttempts and dshRunCap; the group finish applies and checks the persisted digest outputs; each layer records its checked completion evidence and its gate; the report keeps each stage's status, the effective settings and the schedule summary. BR1–BR9 and Card checks gate reports and accepted edits.
preflight.P8: Failure policy (R259): args, source, prepare, digest (no ready unit could be verified) and link-prepare halt. terms, organize, bridge and cleanup continue on a failure. A layer records a content failure against its own unit (`ledger fail -Class content`) and keeps the stage going; a transient transport, lease or provider fault is retryable and that unit is claimed again within maxAttempts, never by rerunning the stage (R258). Modes: link, cards, hubs, figures, audit and bridge; a book type adds its own (models, explain, events, findings, math, resume). Checkpoint: digest (stop before the Cards layer and the book type stages).
preflight.P9: Dry run: zt-econ-digest.sim.json and zt-math-digest.sim.json take mode full through every stage. Fixture: tests/framework-harness.mjs checks the readiness graph, the joins, the group cycle and layer commands, the runner restrictions and the settings on the built scripts (3.0.0: the ledger-driven group cycle, `ledger next -Wait`, the 600000 ms command timeout, the 1200 s provider cap). Pilot: one chapter with cardMax, explainMax, hubTrees, after a database backup.

manager.description: Haiku: relays one script command, runs DeepSeek managers and clean-ups

architect.description: Sonnet: the model architect, writes plan.json only

organizer.description: Opus: the Organize decisions, writes decisions.json only

citationKey.description: the book's BibTeX key (all modes but hubs and audit)

source.description: the book's Chinese or bilingual Markdown (mode full)

book.description: a Scholar Archive Work id or an exact title: mode full resolves the Work, its Chinese/bilingual Markdown, the BibTeX and the heading range instead of source, bibtex and bookTitle

fileId.description: the book Markdown's Scholar Archive file id

startHeading.description: the Chinese heading where the digested text starts

endHeading.description: the Chinese heading where the digested text stops

skipHeadings.description: headings whose units are left out, e.g. 参考文献,习题

groups.description: the existing group count (modes link and models)

organize.description: true: Organize after modes link, models, hubs; "legacy": the old single Opus job

perManager.description: digest groups per Haiku manager (default 5, at most 8)

maxChars.description: the most characters of a group (default 20000)

maxUnits.description: the most units of a group (default 3)

dshSource.description: where DeepSeek V4.1 Flash runs; auto probes official, then OpenCode Go

dshModel.description: a DeepSeek Harness model that overrides dshSource

dshEffort.description: DeepSeek effort of digest, link, and fill runs (raised to high)

rebuild.description: rebuild models that already have parts

dshPerBatch.description: DeepSeek runs one Haiku manager keeps going (default 8, at most 8)

dshManagers.description: Haiku managers of one compiler step in parallel (default 8, at most 8)

linkPerManager.description: link runs one Haiku manager starts at once (default 8)

applyShare.description: jobs one card-cycle apply call writes (default 30)

only.description: the Model Card addresses to work on (a pilot)

level.description: build every model of the run to this level

briefEffort.description: DeepSeek effort of the briefs (raised to high)

deriveEffort.description: DeepSeek effort of the Derivation parts (raised to high)

reviewEffort.description: DeepSeek effort of the review (raised to high)

maxSentences.description: Card size of a formal model part: sentences (default 12)

maxPartChars.description: Card size of a formal model part: characters (default 400)

hubs.description: mode full: false skips the hub stage; mode link: true runs it

hubWork.description: the hub stage's folder and DeepSeek workspace (default D:\zt-digest\hubs)

hubLimits.description: limits that override the Haiku hub manager's choice

hubTrees.description: only these Topic trees (a pilot), e.g. 130,122

hubEffort.description: DeepSeek effort of the hub writers (raised to high)

terms.description: mode full: false skips the book term table

audit.description: mode full: false skips the audit

figures.description: mode full: false skips the Figures stage

cardChecks.description: modes full and link: false skips the card layer cycle

ideaSample.description: share of fault-free Idea Cards reviewed against the source (mode full: 0.1)

cardRules.description: the rules the card cycle fixes (default all hard rules)

cardMax.description: a pilot: at most this many Cards with faults and orphans

explainMax.description: mode explain, a pilot: at most this many Derivation parts

bridge.description: full mode: false skips Bridge discovery

bridgeCandidates.description: similarity candidates per source, default 5 plus at most two literal matches

bridgeReport.description: exact published report id; only mode bridge

bridgeApply.description: all or a unique array of new-carrier ids from bridgeReport

bridgeApplyEarlier.description: separate all or unique array of earlier-carrier ids from bridgeReport

maxAttempts.description: the per-unit attempt budget of the managed run (default 3); persisted at preparation

dshRunCap.description: the seconds one external DeepSeek run may live (default 1200); persisted at preparation

checks.message: args must be an object with citationKey
mode full needs args book, or args source, bibtex, and bookTitle
Bridge acceptance requires mode bridge, a report id, and a nonempty selection
bridgeMax must be a whole number in 1..120
bridgeCandidates must be a whole number in 1..8

stages.title: Prepare
stages.detail: the DeepSeek source (probe official, then OpenCode Go)

stages.title: Prepare
stages.detail: Chinese-only book text, section groups, the Literature tree with anchors, the shared prefixes

stages.title: Prepare
stages.detail: the book term table (book-terms.ps1 and one DeepSeek job)

stages.title: Digest
stages.detail: one ready group per manager chain: claim digest/gNNN@1, snapshot and frozen job, one DeepSeek run, checked group-finish (R250/R252/R253)

stages.title: Cards
stages.detail: the per-group offline Card checks (cards/gNNN@1), claimed from the ready work and recorded by cards-finish

stages.title: Cards
stages.detail: one whole-book card cycle after the digest runs (mode full), or on its own (mode cards); it also reviews the source of every Model draft no model chain elaborates

stages.title: Hubs
stages.detail: mode hubs: the hub compiler on the whole agent Workspace

stages.title: Link
stages.detail: prepare-link-pass.ps1: link files and the pending groups

stages.title: Link
stages.detail: DeepSeek link runs append reasoned cross-part Links

stages.title: Cards
stages.detail: the card layer cycle on the new Links and the orphans

stages.title: Organize
stages.detail: survey → Opus decisions.json → apply → notes card cycle → skeleton (Literature index, structure Card, Topic bodies)

stages.title: Figures
stages.detail: attach-figures.ps1: the book's own figures in the Cards that name them

stages.title: Hubs
stages.detail: the hub compiler on the whole agent Workspace, after Organize

stages.title: Bridge
stages.detail: bounded frozen cross-book discovery and immutable review report; explicit accepted apply in bridge mode

stages.title: Audit
stages.detail: digest-audit.ps1, read-only: faults per rule, orphans, models, figures, hubs

stages.title: Cleanup
stages.detail: delete leftover DeepSeek conversations, remove the workspace and scratch files, read the usage ledger
